lines.zh: 灵魂沙的蓝火，托着我的翅膀。
lines.en: Blue soul fire lifts my wings.
I drift up along the rock face.
The sand below is smoking.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷的风，是蓝的。
lines.en: The wind of the soul sand valley is blue.
I ride a rising column of smoke.
That sand valley is empty and bright.
In the soul sand valley, wind moves the trees.
Blue fire lights up my wings.
There's no water here, only ash.
The soul sand valley has no daytime.
Only stone presses down from above.
Blue fire sways down below.
Blue wings, dusted with ash.
The hot wind lifts me higher.
I steer around that bleached bone.

lines.zh: 我的影子在灵魂沙上拖长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long over the soul sand.
Blue fire burns on my wings.
I settle lightly on soul sand.
The ash smells of scorched bone.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙上，这高度正好发呆。
lines.en: Above soul sand, this height is good for dreaming.
Only the flames make a soft sound.
Blue fire licks slowly at the sand.
I settle on a block of basalt.
My nest is beneath the bone pile.
A ghast is crying somewhere far off.
Ash has settled all over my wings.
Flowers grew here. I remember.
I count the sparks drifting upward.

lines.zh: 你身上带着活人的热气。
lines.en: You carry the warmth of the living.
There's blue fire in your eyes.
You have no wings. How did you get here?

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷的风，吹不散我。
lines.en: The soul sand valley wind can't scatter me.

lines.zh: 下面那个会走路的，抬头。
lines.en: The walking one below, look up.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在你面前发蓝。
lines.en: My wings glow blue in front of you.
Don't scuff the soul sand by my nest.

lines.zh: 焰色的翅，落一层灰给你。
lines.en: Flame-colored wings shed a layer of ash for you.
The name's Soul Butterfly, remember.
The soul sand under your feet is crying out.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙的风，吹乱我的翅。
lines.en: Soul sand wind messes my wings.
The pain drove me into the rock wall.
My wings are smoking blue.
A corner of my wing is torn off.
My wings! Torn.
It is nothing... it truly hurts.
I shed a few blue scales.
My wing is bent; I cannot fly straight.

lines.zh: 我翅上的蓝色淡了一点。
lines.en: The blue on my wings faded a little.
My scale dust was shaken loose.
That smell isn't soul sand.
Don't swing that light in your hand.
What's in that bottle of yours?

lines.zh: 灵魂沙上，我翅下的光发蓝。
lines.en: Over soul sand, the light under my wings is blue.
I land right on your fingertip.
No nectar here, only ash.
The thing you brought is glowing.
Soul sand in your bag — any more?
My blue wings look like a wisp of soul fire.
I'll trade you one blue scale for it.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙谷的风把我吹偏了。
lines.en: Soul Sand Valley wind pushed me off course.
You scattered a swarm of embers.
Your shoulder knocked off my scale dust.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙的缝隙里，我在飞。
lines.en: I fly through the cracks of soul sand.
I circle around your helmet.

lines.zh: 权重只有八，见我算难得。
lines.en: Weight eight—meeting me is rare.
My wings are knocked out of rhythm.
Two loops and my wingtips are dizzy.
This rock face turned out to be alive.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷的风，把我推歪。
lines.en: Soul Sand Valley wind pushed me off.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷里，我认定了。
lines.en: In Soul Sand Valley, I've made my choice.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷的蓝光，是我。
lines.en: That blue light in the Soul Sand Valley is me.
Let our wings touch once.
We fly one circle around the bone heap.
I bring you a wisp of blue fire.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一开一合，像在打拍子。
lines.en: My wings open and close like a beat.
My nest is built into a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我翅上的灰，是灵魂的火。
lines.en: The dust on my wings is soul fire.
Your wings are the same color as mine.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙谷的风，托着我转。
lines.en: The Soul Sand Valley's wind carries my circling.

lines.zh: 蓝色的翅膀，在峡谷里晃。
lines.en: Blue wings waver in the canyon.
A bone shard is buried in the sand.
I wrap my thin legs around it.

lines.zh: 蓝火把我的翅边烤卷了。
lines.en: The blue fire has curled my wing edges.
I wedge it into a rock crevice.
This bone chip will line my nest.

lines.zh: 这块骨头是我先看到的。
lines.en: I saw this bone first.
I struggle to fly while carrying it.
I keep this soul dust under my wing.
This bone shard is still warm.
Do not flutter; I can see you.
That warm mass will feed me a while.
Its wings flicker in the ash.
Your warmth is behind the stone pillar.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙上的蝶，盯上你了。
lines.en: The soul-sand butterfly has its eye on you.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷的蓝火，照着我。
lines.en: The blue fire of the soul sand valley lights me.
That little bug has landed on the sand.
You stand on soul sand, perfect.
I'm so hungry my wings feel light.

lines.zh: 我看见你脚跟扬起的灰。
lines.en: I see the ash your heels kick up.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷的雾，托着我飞。
lines.en: The soul sand haze holds me up.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷，我在骨头上停。
lines.en: In the soul sand valley I rest on bones.
I fly by the soul fire and am not burned.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷的花，只开一朵。
lines.en: Only one bloom in the soul-sand canyon.

lines.zh: 我翅上的蓝，是灵魂火那种蓝。
lines.en: My wings are soul-fire blue.

lines.zh: 你每走一步灰就扬起来。
lines.en: Every step you take kicks up ash.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙谷前面是死路，别飞。
lines.en: Soul sand valley ends ahead; do not fly.
I smell the warmth of the living.

lines.zh: 峡谷的裂缝，你钻不进去。
lines.en: The canyon crack is too narrow for you.
There's nowhere to hide in this valley.
My wing edge slices across your face.
Blue fire already surrounds you.

lines.zh: 让你尝尝我灵魂色的翅膀。
lines.en: Taste my soul-colored wings.
Wings in the sand valley. Down you go.

lines.zh: 我翅上的蓝，是灵魂的颜色。
lines.en: The blue on my wings is soul-colored.
I dive down onto your head.
I land on your shoulder.
Soul dust scatters across your face.

lines.zh: 这片峡谷的蓝，我不许别人碰。
lines.en: None may touch the blue of this valley.
My mouthparts are pointed.
My wings are still blue.
The wind here carries bone ash.
They call me Soul Butterfly.
The wind here is cool.
Grey sand stretches in every direction.
I crawl out from a gap in the bone heap.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙峡谷，一朵花都没有。
lines.en: The Soul Sand Valley has no flowers.
The ash carries me upward.
I knock into a bleached bone.
Blue fire kindles all around me.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙里，我的翅膀在冒烟。
lines.en: In soul sand, my wings are smoking.
I slid off the ledge into the sand.
There's water beside the blue fire, of all things.
The blast flipped my wings over.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的蓝，被箭划了一道。
lines.en: An arrow scored the blue on my wing.
Magic touched my wing veins.
There's no nectar in soul sand.
Blue sparks are spraying off my wings.
Not even ash falls here.
